## How to sign

Open a pull request. The CLA Assistant bot will ask you to comment:

> I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA

Your signature (GitHub username, user id, pull request and date) is recorded on the `cla-signatures` branch of this repository. You sign once; it covers all future Contributions.
